notes.title: Latest Update Live
notes.content:
Hi all,  We are back with a working updatable game!

The first of the 3-4 updates rewriting the Gorilla AI and social interactions are live.  It is now much clearer the effect on the female gorillas of achieving tasks like feeding, making a nest, achieving loyalty. 

A couple of important bug fixes have also been added.  Branches for making nests were occasionally disappearing under the terrain, this should no longer happen making it much easier to find branches to build nests.
rescaled the minimap so it is less cluttered and easier to see items close by.
Added nest icon (home) so no longer need the smoke signal on nests.

A couple of nice improvements along with the fixes:-

The terrain is now twice the Size at 4 square kilometres.
Certain errors that have fixed have resulted in a huge increase in frame rate along with denser vegetation.  My test machine now runs at an average of 90fps from 60fps

Couple of ideas I am testing:-
Adding icons to make even clearer regarding the troop needs.
Adding a sense button which will then add an outline to items of interest within a radius. Potentially, animals, food, branches, nests. to help locate them.

Adding a call button to any nearby female gorillas.

There is still more progress to be made in regard to player feedback and more interactions.  The infant gorillas have a lot more work to be done once you have gotten to the mating stage and they will be the focus of the last AI update once the female Gorillas are finished.

Andy

notes.title: Rolled back last update yesterday
notes.content:
The first AI/social interactions update was posted last night but I had to take it down temporarilybecause of a compatibility issue with the package.  I am working on the patch now and hope to get that update out today or as soon as the issue is addressed.

Andy

notes.title: Road map update
notes.content:
Hi there,  I hope you have all had a positive start to the year.

I wanted to write a post about the next update in the works.  I've been really struggling with getting the social aspects of the troop right.  It's by far the most difficult part of the project but I wanted to reach out and say it is being addressed and to any player that thought the game development had finished it is far from it.

I have decided to implement another level of relationship between the gorillas which I hope will finally give the AI of the troop the feel I am going after.  This is on top of the quests or tasks the females can ask the silverback to complete,  giving more purpose to player.

I will keep you informed of the progress and hope to have some updates each week over the next three or four when I feel we can then have solid relationship structure for the troop to sit along side the survival elements in there now.

I really appreciate the support and I am striving to make this a unique and interesting indie title.  Please reach out with comments, forum posts or private messages if you have any feedback, ideas.

Andy

notes.title: Update live
notes.content:
A quick update which fixes camera clipping in the terrain and trees.

Also adjusted the volumetric light settings so they reflect time of day better and also the current weather.

notes.title: Update live
notes.content:
Good evening all,  The latest update adds a minmap radar system to the HUD.  Some players have been having issues with the difficulty level so this feature should help.

Currently it only detects Female Gorillas.  We can easily add predaotrs/rivals or in fact all the animals if this is reuired.  I will test adding to all food and thes nests too.

Feedback would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: Terrain Update
notes.content:
A new update is live which improves CPU performance.  This is the first of several terrain updates that will move usuage from the CPU to the GPU.  This should be especially helpful for AMD based rigs but everyone should benefit.

I noticed a few reports of slow movement which will be related to FPS, this should really help.  I am going to open a couple of disussion threads so any reports can be placed there and if you could add you machine details that will be really helpful in targeting any issues.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
A small update has been released adding a few more varieties of ferns to the rain forest biomes.  

We have also added an action for the rival male gorillas.  They can now steal your food.   More actions for all the gorillas are being later in the week.

Andy

notes.title: Update live and game is released tomorrow.
notes.content:
Special thanks to everyone who has helped support us in early access.  The game goes full release tomorrow and then I will update on the roadmap for future additions with hopefully take further feedback and ideas.

Next week I will also try get some initial information out our next game which all Lonely Gorilla early access owners get the first episode free.

Thank you all!

notes.title: New Update out now
notes.content:
Latest vesion is release candidate one for transitioning out of early access.  6 achievements added.  New animals, biomes and activities.

I missed the publishing deadline for Friday night so we will be out of early access next week - the game is already live to all early access buyers of course.

Thanks for all the support and feedback.  I still want to add lots more content and another game mode in the future.  I also look forward to player feedback and feature/mode requests.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: Update live
notes.content:
More improvements to the vegetation and AI.  We are just waiting for a few more small fixes to the AI damage and quest mechanics.  

Initial release will be Friday night or Saturday morning depending on region.

Last chance to grab a free episode of our next game.

Thanks,

Andy

notes.title: New Update out now
notes.content:
Another step closer.

Some small changes and optimisations.

Further work integrating quests.  Fixed the crocodile bug.  Added two survival based achievments.  Survive a game day and survive and game week.

I still want to adjust the animals AI further before adding achievments relating to them.  

We have two AI systems, one for the gorillas and one for all the other animals and we just need to get them communicating both ways.  Currently all gorillas can hurt the other animals but it is not working the other way around.

We should be adding the quests for the baby gorillas and fixing the AI integration mentioned above and then the game will get first initial release.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: New Update out now
notes.content:
A step closer to release.

More animals added.  Rhino, hippo, lion, lioness, crocodile, and elephants.  Still more work to do on the AI and to link in the achievements but hopefully we will get more progress to that tomorrow.

The quests are working from the female gorillas but are not linked to achievements yet.

New biomes added for rivers/coastline, rainforest,mountains and savannah.

Another day or two for initial full release but work will of course still continue after that.

We look forward to getting feedback for new features and additions.

New/current purchasers still qualify for a free copy of the first episode of our next game titled "Lightmare Castle"  A story driven medieval adventure.

notes.title: New update live 21/10/2018
notes.content:
Latest version is live as we move towards initial full release.  We have fixed the black and white lighting glitch after finally being able to replicate it.

Improvements to the terrain and rendering means we are now hitting 60fps average on our mid-range test PC (i7 4790k CPU, 660ti GPU). (1080p).  More improvements will be made soon.

The quest system is in and producing procedural quests from female gorillas.  This is the first version and will be added to in the next update.

As mentioned before as an extra bonus and thank you for your support all Early Access owners will be eligible to receive the first episode of our next game free of charge.  This will be announced as we move towards full release which is still on schedule for the end of this month with a few days give or take.

We are busy working on adding the new animals and AI behaviour along with refining the quest system and linking with achievements.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: Update and achievements coming soon
notes.content:
Just a quick announcement that a new update will be delivered shortly (next week or so) with achievements included.  I have had to focus on the business side of things for the last few weeks but that is completed now so the focus is back on updates.  

After that we will list the road map to leaving early access which is still on schedule for 6-10 weeks time.  

We will also announce a bonus for all early assess purchases which we hope everyone will appreciate.

Andy

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
Fixed some issues regarding vegetation and lighting.  

Improved terrain and texturing.  

Theses fixes have also brought a nice 5+fps boast to the game.  Test PC now getting 45-50FPS.

notes.title: Rain Update
notes.content: Fixed the excessive rain.  The tropical climate still leads to regular rainfall but the weather system should now change daily.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
A small update that reduces damage from Leopards and tweaks AI of rival male Gorilla.  

I have also unlocked the framerate for the game so players can benefit from higher spec machines.  

I am getting 40+fps on a decent but old test machine @1080p with all settings high.

Spec of test machine.

i7 4790-K
16gb Ram
660TI GPU


Achievements and trading cards are being worked on by our artists and hopefully they will be included very soon.

Andy

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
Latest build has an initial help page and some improvement to the animal fights.

Rivals and predators now try to attack your troop members as well as the player.

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
Fixed bug making you slide on high sloped terrain when sleeping.  Improved leopard movement and increased damage from players and AI.

Currently working on an in game help page to go over basics at the beginning of each game.  This should be completed and added to game today.

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
Fixed terrain shader error where rain effects were not showing when it rained.

Improved some elements of Male gorilla and leopard.  More to follow.  Leopard is showing some strange behaviour - working on another update now hopefully live tomorrow but I wanted to test the terrain live.

Andy.

Work started on achievements, documentation and trading cards.

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content: Fixed shelter system bug.  Large trees such as Coconut, Kapok, banyan now provide shelter from rain and storms.

notes.title: New Update 22/05/18
notes.content:
Keyboard control improvement.  We have added a walk button (Left Shift).  Run is still on "W" and if you hold both together you have a faster run.  Speed of player turn as been adjusted slightly.  

Joypad/Steam controller is unchanged as these speeds are already mapped to the left stick.

The map redesign is going very well and we should have a completely new terrain in the next week or so.

We will then look to finalise the social aspect for the troop and the move to the narrative of game and starting position for the player.

At this point we will begin game balancing and look to move out of early access.

Kind regards,

Andy

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
New update improves the save system including saving troop stats.

We are now adding some further actions for the infant gorillas.  Next on the list is the rival male gorillas that you can encounter.

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
This update has our first version of the save system.  

Players details are all saved along with troop members positions.  Currently troop members vitals are not saved.  The feature will be finalised once we leave early access so can be subject to change.  Once it is locked down it will be incorporated with steam cloud.

Player has been moved back near the female gorillas for testing.  All vitals must be very high for the female gorilla to successfully give birth to an infant.

notes.title: Update Now Live
notes.content:
This update includes a overhaul of the scoring system.  Points are now awarded for most activities like eating, building a nest, mating, having an infant and adding new members to the troop.  With much larger awards for troop additions and babies.

Currently if the requirements are met the female gorilla will go to their home location and give birth.

The troop status is now shown in basic form with number of members and infants listed.

Items coming soon include


    Gestation period before birth
    Animations and actions for infants
    Female gorilla actions
    Troop instruction Follow


Some documentation is being added and then the work will begin on the terrain overhaul with biomes.

notes.title: Update live
notes.content:
Latest update now live.  

Some changes have been made to the terrain textures and fixed some collision issues between the animals.

Female gorillas can now have babies under the right conditions.  Lots still to add but the possibility is now there.

On this point I am going to start a discussion thread as I think about documentation I would love some feedback about how much information you think should be given, and how much if any should be done to the player to work out.  Check out the thread for more info on this and to give us your thoughts.

Thanks

Andy

notes.title: Update 29/04/18
notes.content:
The latest update has corrected the bonding.  Grooming now has internal cool down time.  Turning has be increased for the player.

Fixed a calculation for volumetric light and moisture.

Along with ongoing improvements we are now working on the addition of offspring with any female gorilla who has achieved full troop loyalty and is in good overall health and silver-back bonding

Kind regards,

Andy

notes.title: Update 27/04/18
notes.content:
We have added more leopards to test troop interactions.  AI gorillas will now attack leopards to defend the troop/player.

Randomised some values for the gorillas so they act differently to each other.

notes.title: New Update Live 25/04/18
notes.content:
Lots of features added under the hood for the female gorilla.  She now has lots of possible interactions depending on status.  They're three females nearby for testing.  You can find them and change them from wild to troop member with interactions.  The can be given food and made nests for.

The features are not all hooked up for example you can easily get them in the troop by repeating the interaction, this will not be the case in the game.  

Even full troop member cannot have offspring at this time.  These new features will be tested and fully integrated then we will move on to creating offspring.

After this the troop will be moved away and the game structure will be finalised as you are separated from your troop at the start of each game.

notes.title: Update live.
notes.content:
I've added a signal effect to the nest to help locate them when you are close by.  

A fix for the bamboo collider and some small changes to the animal AI.

Andy

notes.title: Update 18/04/18. Improved physics and added tree collisions.
notes.content: Interactions with animals improved and fixed going through trees.

notes.title: Update Live 17/04/18
notes.content:
We have added the leaderboard to the game over screen.  This now stores the best score you have and uploads the result.  The scoring system will change a lot as we add features.

We have tweaked the animal settings so they should not die so quick.  

Our focus is now the animals and their AI so they will be changing a lot over the next few days but should be closer to the final settings.

notes.title: Update fix for bamboo roll 17/04/18
notes.content:
Hi, thanks for the report on the bamboo rolling away.  This should now be fixed making it much easier to make nests for the gorilla.  You will also see information displayed on the female gorilla showing her needs.  

This is part of a bigger update that should be live today or tomorrow.  This interface along with audio and animation cues from the AI gorillas will help the player understand what the troop need to increase bonding.  High bonding is vital to keep the troop together and allow it to grow with mating.

Regards,

Andy

notes.title: Update Live
notes.content:
A small update to adjust a few player animation speeds.  

The leaderboard test was a success so we are now working on the UI to go with the score.

Playtesting the new map system and we hope to have the first live build of this next week.  This will increase the map size a lot and begin showing the separate biomes for grassland, rain forests etc....


Andy

notes.title: New Update 11/04/18
notes.content:
Evening all,  there is a new update live which adds steam leaderboards for testing.  Once the scores start showing we will update with UI.  This is a testing leaderboard so will be subject to change.  

Currently it just adds a score based on time survived but in future in will include number of offspring, size of troop achieved etc....

There is also a few tweaks to the Leopard AI with attack changes and sounds added.

Fight mode now automatically enables when a predator is nearby.  This is a test and subject to change so please let us know which you prefer.

Andy

notes.title: New Update 07/04/18
notes.content:
We've just pushed our latest update.  As mentioned in the roadmap our first tentative steps with troop interactions.  Female gorillas have new animations and audio to let you know what they require.  More info to come on this.  You can also affect their bonding level with one interaction (much more to come).

The Male Gorilla will also show aggression towards you if you hurt them.  Please bear in mind fight mode is very early in development and is only really there for testing purposes currently and changing AI behaviour as some of it is linked to AI health.

EDIT:- We also changed the turn speed of the player as referenced by one of the user reviews.  Thanks for the feedback on that and others it is really appreciated and helps speed up development and direction.  Please keep it coming and let us know if this has improved the movement.

Thanks,

Andy

notes.title: New Update Live
notes.content:
Good evening all,  I have just pushed a new update which helps make the config screen a little easier to understand (I hope).  

We have some additions to animal AI and audio.  Added basic flee and attack for Giraffe with audio plus Death animation.  

We have also started work on the Gorilla interactions.  A couple of small things have been added to Male Gorilla and Female Gorilla.  Animation and Audio reaction to player.  All animals have been moved closer to player for testing and we have re positioned your starting point.  Any issues or comments please let us know.

Andy

notes.title: Small Update Now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just pushed a small update that fixes the sliding of the player.  You can move better and get to more areas.  Also some small changes to prey AI so they react and flee aggression from the player or predators.

Edit:- quick fix so player visible wetness now affected by rivers/streams and visible drying when in shelter.

Andy

notes.title: Update 1 Now live
notes.content:
Thanks for your initial comments and apologies for the mix up with the controls and not getting docs prepared.

On Screen Buttons 

This update has fixed controls onscreen.
You can now simply click the onscreen buttons to perform the same options as the joypad buttons or keyboard.

Key Config Screen

The key config screen is now implemented and working.
Default controls are listed but can be changed to your liking.

The above is for keyboard, the joypad buttons are set for now but will be updated soon.

I hope this has not put too many people off and you can try again to play the game.

There is much more to come and again apologies for small team mistakes but I hope you can continue the journey to make this a fun experience.

Regards,

Andy

Funderground games
